description: GLM-5.2-Fast-Preview is the high-speed variant of Zhipu AI's GLM-5.2, with 1M context and capabilities on par with the standard version. Inference-optimized to deliver 1.5–2× the output TPS, it fits latency-sensitive use cases such as real-time chat, multi-turn agents, and streaming code generation.
name: Z.ai: GLM 5.2 Fast
